topic.title: Neha starts a ₹3,000 SIP at 22 and stops at 32; Karan starts at 32 and goes on to 55

cta: Tell us the age you will start
title: Neha stopped early and still beat Karan by a mile
description: Two friends, the same ₹3,000 a month, an assumed 12% a year. One starts ten years earlier and stops ten years earlier. Returns are assumptions, not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
